questions.question: Which LP emphasizes mechanisms over good intentions?
options: Insist on the Highest Standards (and related mechanism culture)
questions.explanation: Amazon culture rewards durable mechanisms — checklists, automation, bars — not heroics.

questions.question: "Disagree and Commit" requires that after disagreement you:
options: Fully support the decision publicly and execute

questions.question: Invent and Simplify is NOT:
options: Removing steps that do not add customer value
questions.explanation: Complexity is a cost in Network Core.

questions.question: Earn Trust includes delivering:
questions.explanation: Managers represent networking to customers — trust is currency.

questions.question: Dive Deep anti-pattern for managers:
options: Delegating all technical understanding permanently and never verifying
Sampling tickets and pairing on hard issues
Asking probing questions in design reviews
questions.explanation: JD: technical leaders dive deep and help engineers decide well.

questions.question: Bias for Action still requires:
options: Calculated risk with reversible steps when stakes are high
questions.explanation: Safe ops + bias for action coexist via reversible changes.

questions.question: Frugality does NOT justify:
options: Removing monitoring to save license cost without a replacement
Preferring automation over headcount for toil

questions.question: Think Big without Deliver Results fails when you:
options: Only present vision slides with no milestones or metrics
Ship incremental capacity with a multi-year architecture
questions.explanation: Amazon wants both vision and delivery.

questions.question: Are Right, A Lot includes:
options: Seeking diverse perspectives and updating beliefs
questions.explanation: Leaders use data and voices across the org.

questions.question: Learn and Be Curious for network managers:
options: Stay current on protocols/tools and teach the team

questions.question: Earth's Best Employer in a 24x7 network team means:
options: Fair rotations, recovery time, and addressing chronic pages
Unlimited pages as a badge of honor
questions.explanation: JD explicitly covers 24x7 operational rotation health.

questions.question: Broad Responsibility example:
options: Designing change so a failure does not cascade to unrelated customers
Optimizing only your team's ticket count

questions.question: Ownership of a Sev-1 after your shift ends:
options: Stay engaged or ensure a clean handoff with context — do not disappear
Close laptop immediately with no handoff
questions.explanation: Ownership transcends shift boundaries until ownership is clear.

questions.question: Customer Obsession metric for network ops:
options: Customer-impacting minutes / error budgets — not only device uptime

questions.question: Deliver Results story needs:
options: Baseline, action, and quantified outcome with your role clear
A long list of meetings attended
Job titles of people you know

questions.question: Hire and Develop includes performance management when:
options: You give timely feedback, clear expectations, and growth plans — including hard conversations
You avoid feedback until annual review
You outsource all coaching to HR forever
questions.explanation: JD: performance management and team health.
